headline: Reviewed the updated work plan and the status of data from city and agency sources.
summary: The minutes list a checklist of ten data sources, such as 211, DPW, and Fire/EMS, each with an assigned member. Survey results, agency questions, and public comment were also listed as topics.

HOMELESS SERVICES GAP ANALYSIS COMMITTEE 
 
  NOVEMBER 19, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee was held Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 1:04 
p.m. in the Aldermanic Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance 
with the requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 5 members of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee present:   
 
Chairman Goodman presided. 
 
Members of the Committee present: Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg, Clerk 
 Alderman Thomas Lopez (1:34 p.m.) 
 LaTonya Muccioli 
 Tonia Knisley, Vice-Chairman 
 Jane Goodman, Chairman 
  
Members of the Committee absent: Megan Caron, Chief of Staff  
 Bobbie Bagley, Public Health Director 
 
Also in Attendance:
